# Download Owner's Vision

[Download owners-vision.zip](https://github.com/ammarbalkhi/owners-vision/releases/latest/download/owners-vision.zip)

Extract the `owners-vision/` folder into your agent's project-local skill directory, then ask the agent to use it. The agent checks project readiness and helps you establish the approved vision. See [agent setup](../docs/agent-usage.md).

The [release page](https://github.com/ammarbalkhi/owners-vision/releases/latest) includes the ZIP's SHA-256 checksum.

## What the counter measures

The README badge uses GitHub's download count for the `owners-vision.zip` release asset, summed across published versions. Repeat downloads count separately; the number does not measure unique people or confirmed installations.

Clones, copied files, GitHub's automatic source archives, and earlier downloads of the ZIP from the repository are outside this count. No reporting code is added to the skill.

For future releases, keep the asset filename `owners-vision.zip` so the download link and cumulative counter continue to work. Publish the ZIP with its matching source version and SHA-256 checksum.
